title: Energy relaxation via quantum thermalization: A superconducting qubit coupled to an interacting many-body two-level system
summary: Two-level systems (TLS) are widely recognized as a dominant source of energy relaxation in superconducting qubits, limiting coherence times and device performance. While TLS-induced dissipation is often modeled as independent channels, interacting TLS can form finite many-body environments whose dynamical role in qubit relaxation remains insufficiently understood.
